name: The Kingsroad
cites: World of Ice & Fire: the Kingsroad 'reaching hundreds of leagues to Castle Black and the Wall'
AFFC, Brienne: at the crossroads 'the kingsroad, the river road, and the high road all came together'
ADWD, Jon: 'half a league south of Mole's Town' on the kingsroad

wiki Kingsroad: Storm's End, Bronzegate, kingswood, River Gate opposite King's Landing, east of the Gods Eye, Harrenhal, crossroads inn, east of the Green Fork and the Twins, Moat Cailin, Winterfell, west of Long Lake and Last Hearth, Castle Black
blog: 2600 mi

name: The Gold Road
cites: World of Ice & Fire: the plains 'south of the Blackwater, near to where the Goldroad would run one day'
ASOS, Catelyn: a defensive position 'athwart the gold road'
wiki Goldroad: Lion Gate at King's Landing, crosses the Blackwater south of Stoney Sept, guarded by Deep Den, ends at Lannisport and Casterly Rock
blog: 800 mi

name: The Roseroad
cites: ACOK, Catelyn: Renly's host 'near Bitterbridge, where the roseroad crosses the Mander'
ACOK, Tyrion: Renly 'marches up the roseroad' from Highgarden
wiki Roseroad: splits from the kingsroad just south of King's Landing, Bitterbridge, Highgarden, southwest to Oldtown

name: The Ocean Road
cites: World of Ice & Fire: 'King Mern of the Reach rode the Ocean Road north to Casterly Rock'
wiki Ocean Road: from Lannisport south along the coast, through the forest round Crakehall, Old Oak, then inland to Highgarden

name: River Road
cites: AFFC, Brienne: 'West ran the river road, which followed the course of the Red Fork to Riverrun'
wiki River road: Casterly Rock, Sarsfield, Golden Tooth, Riverrun, the Red Fork, the inn at the crossroads

name: The High Road
cites: AFFC, Brienne: 'The high road would take them east through the mountains to the Vale of Arryn'
AGOT, Catelyn: 'the western end of the valley, where the high road crested the last pass'
wiki Bloody Gate: located along the high road

AGOT, Catelyn: from the Bloody Gate the party descends to the valley floor and reaches 'the stout castle that stood at the foot of the Giant's Lance' (the Gates of the Moon) after dark; the Eyrie is the climb above it
AFFC, Sansa: the Gates of the Moon 'guarded the steps up to the Eyrie'

name: The Rosby Road
cites: ACOK, Tyrion: 'a trap along the Rosby road'; AFFC, Cersei: they 'ride along the Rosby road to hunt for shells and eat beside the sea'
wiki Rosby: 'the shortest road between the capital and Duskendale'

name: The Boneway
cites: ASOS, Tyrion: 'climb the Boneway, turn east near Summerhall, and come up the kingsroad'
AFFC, The Princess in the Tower: Wyls of the Boneway; 'eight days on the Boneway', Yronwood feasts him 'when he emerged from the mountains'
wiki Boneway: through the Red Mountains from Yronwood, past the Wyl, to Summerhall

name: The Prince's Pass
cites: World of Ice & Fire: 'the Prince's Pass, the gateway through the Red Mountains', at their western end; its mountain lords were the Lords of Skyreach, 'Lords of the Wide Way'

name: The Demon Road
cites: ADWD, The Merchant's Man: 'the one that ran eastward from Volantis to Meereen had earned a more sinister name: the demon road'
wiki Demon road: Volantis, Mantarys, the ruins of Bhorash, Meereen

name: The Ghiscari Coast Road
cites: ADWD, Daenerys: 'the old Valyrian road that ran beside it [Slaver's Bay] through sand and desolation until it vanished in the west'
ADWD, The Windblown: 'the old Ghiscari coast road' Astapor to Yunkai to Meereen

name: The Valyrian Road
cites: blog 2016-04-25 (Daenerys journey): Drogo departs Pentos by the Valyrian straight roads; from Qohor the road runs east through the Forest of Qohor
World of Ice & Fire, wonders made by man: the Valyrian roads run from Pentos in the north-west to Bhorash and Sarnath in the east
ADWD, Tyrion: Illyrio's litter on 'the hard Valyrian road' east of Pentos

name: The Steel Road
cites: World of Ice & Fire: 'The Steel Road ... and the Stone Road both originate in Vaes Dothrak, the former running almost due east beneath the highest peaks', escorting caravans 'to and from Kayakayanaya'

name: The Stone Road
cites: World of Ice & Fire: the Stone Road 'curving southeast to join the old Silk Road at the ruins of Yinishar (called Vaes Jini by the horselords) before beginning its climb', 'passes beneath the walls of Samyriana'

name: The Sand Road
cites: World of Ice & Fire: 'the Sand Road passes through the southern Bones ... connecting the great port city of Qarth with the market city Tiqui, the gateway to the east'; Bayasabhad 'guards the eastern end of the Sand Road'
